replication.target_description: Experiment 2 replication: determiner by verb-type interaction at word 16, looking. Both full 3x2 and restricted full-verb/local-ellipsis 2x2 tests match; supplied locator does not select one.

n.sample_role: Analytic participant N unresolved; recruitment participants, retained-item candidate, and reading-time observations are separate roles.
n.exclusions: 8 of 80 participants omitted for language/US eligibility; 8 of 60 target items excluded below 60% accuracy; only correct trials; RT trimming as Experiment 1. Final model observation count not printed.
n.quote:
80 participants from Amazon.com’s Mechanical Turk who did not take part in
Experiment 1 took part in this self-paced reading study. We analyzed only participants
who said that they were native speakers of English from the US. This resulted in omitting
the data from 8 of the initial 80 participants. ... We present analyses with items with at least
60% accuracy, thus excluding 8 of the 60 items (12, 16, 17, 22, 29, 40, 42, 60). ... Following HKV, we analyze only correct trials in the analyses that we present here, and
we performed participant and item ANOVAs on each of these regions. ... word 16: F1(2,144) = 1.51, p = .225; F2(2,102) = 2.82, p = .065; word 17:
F1(2,144) = 0.121, p = .886; F2(2,102) = 0.484, p = .618; word 18: F1(2,144) = 0.678, p
= .509; F2(2,102) = 0.602, p = .55. Nor did we find the predicted interaction between
verb type and determiner in the restricted 2x2 conditions, where the verb type is
constrained to (full-verb, local-ellipsis): word 15: F1(1,72) = 0.307, p = .581; F2(1,51) =
0.955, p = .333; word 16: F1(1,72) = 2.478, p = .12; F2(1,51) = 3.53, p = .066;

notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a full 21-page primary empirical manuscript titled An attempted replication of Hackl, Koster-Hale, Varvoutis (2012), by Edward Gibson and Roger Levy, manuscript dated April 30, 2016. Title, authors, year, and Experiment 2 match the neutral replication reference. The text contains methods, results, figures and references. The supplied arXiv DOI/version identifier is not printed in the text and cannot be independently confirmed without forbidden acquisition. No PDF was supplied. Section 3.3 reports 80 recruited participants and omission of 8; candidate retained participant count by subtraction is 80 - 8 = 72, but this is not a printed final critical-model N or a documented sum of mutually exclusive final groups. Section 3.4 reports 8 excluded items from 60; candidate retained item count is 60 - 8 = 52, separate from participants. Only correct trials were analyzed, with Experiment 1 RT trimming reused (RTs below 90 msec or above 3 seconds removed, residual RTs beyond two SD per condition/position excluded). No final trial/observation count is printed. The participant ANOVAs print denominator df 144 (3x2) and 72 (restricted 2x2); these do not unambiguously corroborate the recruitment/exclusion-derived participant candidate. No N is inferred from df. Thus no analytic N is promoted to a positive extraction. Target ambiguity: word 16 full 3x2 F1(2,144) = 1.51, p = .225; F2(2,102) = 2.82, p = .065; restricted 2x2 F1(1,72) = 2.478, p = .12; F2(1,51) = 3.53, p = .066. Neither design selected. Only assigned unfinished field n_r was assessed; other statistic and success fields are unassigned placeholders.
